name: 21971-embedbatch-qwen06bfp8-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-FP8, NOT SUBSTITUTED. ~1.1 GiB in one safetensors shard, public and ungated; block-FP8 weights (e4m3, 128x128 blocks) over a bf16 activation path. Served as an embedding model: under `--is-embedding` the checkpoint's LAST-token pooler answers `/v1/embeddings` with one normalised vector per document and never generates a token.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 48000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. 36000 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` against `/v1/embeddings`, single turn, no shared prefix: exactly 512 prompt tokens per request, pinned with no spread, and no generated tokens at all (`output_tokens` is omitted, which is guidellm's documented way of driving an endpoint that produces none).
purpose: A semantic search embedding service turning 512-token documents into vectors for 64 concurrent clients on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id:`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is DROPPED and the engine then runs without
# something this file declares, at rc=0. A structured value must stay on one line. Environment
# variables cannot live here. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`, `false` emits nothing.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-FP8
tp-size: 1

# The endpoint: this checkpoint's LAST-token pooler serves `/v1/embeddings` and `is_generation`
# goes false.
is-embedding: true

# `-1` is the engine's own "disabled" value for chunked prefill. The scheduler still bounds a
# prefill batch at the stock `max-prefill-tokens` (16384).
chunked-prefill-size: -1

disable-radix-cache: true
